name: Microsoft Exchange Trace Logs
description: The MessageTrace API provides information about the processing of email messages that have passed through the Office 365 system for the organization. The Sumo Logic App for Microsoft Exchange Trace Logs provides visibility into Delivered, Failed, Quarantined, Pending, and Spam messages. The App Dashboard also analyzes the delivery Status of Messages, the size of messages transmitted, and the geolocation of senders and receivers, and provides threat analysis for the sender's email with the CrowdStrike threat detection feed.

children.name: Microsoft Exchange Trace Logs - Message Monitoring
children.description: This Dashboard mainly focuses on the message traffic i.e. gives the count of unique senders, receivers and respective unique domains. It provides the geo location of senders, receivers and the messages which are failed. It also does the threat detection analysis of senders for security.
children.title: Microsoft Exchange Trace Logs - Message Monitoring

panels.title: Geo Location of Senders

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory=Labs/MessageExchangeTraceLogs 
| json "Organization", "MessageId", "Received","SenderAddress", "RecipientAddress", "Subject", "Status", "ToIP", "FromIP", "Size", "MessageTraceId", "StartDate", "EndDate", "Index" as organization, message_id, received, sender_address, recipient_address, subject, status, toIP, fromIP, size, message_traceId, start_date, end_Date, index nodrop
| where status matches"{{status}}"
| where sender_address matches"{{sender_address}}"
| where organization matches "{{organization}}"
| where isValidIP(fromIP) and !isPrivateIP(fromIP)
| count as IPCount by fromIP
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = fromIP
| where country_name matches "{{country}}"

panels.title: Threat Intel Analysis of Senders Email Address

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory=Labs/MessageExchangeTraceLogs 
| json "Organization", "MessageId", "Received","SenderAddress", "RecipientAddress", "Subject", "Status", "ToIP", "FromIP", "Size", "MessageTraceId", "StartDate", "EndDate", "Index" as organization, message_id, received, sender_address, recipient_address, subject, status, toIP, fromIP, size, message_traceId, start_date, end_Date, index nodrop
| where status matches"{{status}}"
| where sender_address matches"{{sender_address}}"
| where organization matches "{{organization}}"
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = fromIP
| where country_name matches "{{country}}"
| count as email_count by sender_address, _source
| lookup type, actor, raw, threatlevel as malicious_confidence from sumo://threat/cs on threat=sender_address
| json field=raw "labels[*].name" as label_name 
| replace(label_name, "\\/","->") as label_name
| replace(label_name, "\""," ") as label_name
| where type="email_address" and !isNull(malicious_confidence)
| if (isEmpty(actor), "Unassigned", actor) as Actor
|sum (email_count) as threat_count by sender_address, malicious_confidence, Actor,  _source, label_name
| sort by threat_count

panels.title: Top 10 Message Status Count by Sender

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory=Labs/MessageExchangeTraceLogs 
| json "Organization", "MessageId", "Received","SenderAddress", "RecipientAddress", "Subject", "Status", "ToIP", "FromIP", "Size", "MessageTraceId", "StartDate", "EndDate", "Index" as organization, message_id, received, sender_address, recipient_address, subject, status, toIP, fromIP, size, message_traceId, start_date, end_Date, index nodrop
| where status matches"{{status}}"
| where sender_address matches"{{sender_address}}"
| where organization matches "{{organization}}"
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = fromIP
| where country_name matches "{{country}}"
| count by sender_address, status
| transpose row sender_address column status as Delivered ,None, Failed, Pending, Expanded, Quarantined, FilteredAsSpam 
| sum(Delivered) as Delivered, sum(None) as None, sum(Failed) as Failed, sum(Pending) as Pending, sum(Expanded) as Expanded, sum(Quarantined) as Quarantined, sum(FilteredAsSpam) as FilteredAsSpam by sender_address
| (Delivered + None+ Failed + Pending + Expanded + Quarantined + FilteredAsSpam) as TotalCount 
| sort by TotalCount
| limit 10
